changelog:
Initial release of GitHub Release Watcher.

- Monitor one or more GitHub repositories for new releases.
- Requires GitHub CLI (`gh`) and a simple config file (`repos.txt`).
- Provides an easy shell script workflow for checking and notification.
- Supports integration with cron jobs and heartbeat checks.
- Outputs concise status for new and existing releases.
- Tracks last seen releases in a local JSON state file.
summary: Monitor specified GitHub repositories for new releases and receive notifications of newly detected tags.
